__comment: Command dock. Dock items and every menu show Hearthblock icons (assets/ui/icons, doc 259) on their family tile (icon_families.json); Development and its DEV tools sit on the DEV tile. Labels appear on hover/focus. Colony opens its page, and 'colony' lists the entries that page shows as buttons (doc 23). UIRegistry owns layout; DockUI owns dispatch.

items.label: Orders
items.tooltip: Mining, chopping and cancelling work orders

items.label: Zones
items.tooltip: Designate storage areas. Farming and animal pastures are planned.

items.label: Rooms
items.tooltip: Inspect enclosed rooms, temperature and lighting

items.label: Construction
items.tooltip: Build blocks and shapes, copy what you built and place blueprints

items.label: Place
items.tooltip: Place finished furniture and replant uprooted shrubs

items.label: Craft
items.tooltip: Choose a profession to open its crafting menu

items.label: Colony
items.tooltip: Your settlement at a glance: its name, dwarves, food, beds, storage and happiness

items.label: Inventory
items.tooltip: Browse colony supplies, check quantities and find items

items.label: Events
items.tooltip: Arrivals, discoveries, colony news and warnings. The count shows what is new; it turns rust while a warning stands.

items.label: Menu
items.tooltip: Save, load, start a new colony, settings and exit. Esc opens it too.

items.label: Development
items.tooltip: Development and testing tools

items.label: Build
items.tooltip: Place blocks of stone, dirt, grass or wood: 1 rough stone, soil or log a block. Q and E change the material. Haulers fill a materials crate, then a builder hammers each block for 3 seconds. Click or drag; Alt + wheel adjusts height.

items.label: Shapes
items.tooltip: Lay Build's materials out as a shape: a rectangle or a circle, as walls or filled, or a flight of stairs. Tab changes the shape and Q and E the material. Each block is still planned, built and mined on its own.

items.label: Copy
items.tooltip: Drag a box round what you built or planned to keep it as a blueprint, every block as the material that builds it. Alt + wheel sets the box's height; F takes its floor too.

items.label: Blueprints
items.tooltip: The starter blueprints and your own: place one as plans, rename or delete yours, or open the folder their files are kept in to share them.

items.label: Rudimentary
items.tooltip: Worker recipes made with basic tools and the crude workbench.

items.label: Carpenter
items.tooltip: The Carpenter's page: their own bench first, made at the crude workbench.

items.label: Stonemason
items.tooltip: The Stonemason's page: their own bench first, made at the crude workbench.

items.label: Blacksmith
items.tooltip: Browse planned metalwork: tools, fittings, weapons and armor.

items.label: Farmer
items.tooltip: Browse planned farming tools and supplies.

items.label: Ranger
items.tooltip: Fish dried on the rack. Hunting comes later.

items.label: Miner
items.tooltip: Browse the mining-equipment catalog. Miner is already a playable profession; this crafting catalog is a preview.

items.label: Brewer
items.tooltip: Browse planned brewing and aging equipment.

items.label: Mine blocks
items.tooltip: Drag to mark blocks. Shift + wheel changes width; Alt + wheel changes depth. Ctrl removes marks.

items.label: Chop trees
items.tooltip: Click a tree or drag around several to mark them for felling.

items.label: Clear stones
items.tooltip: Click or drag to mark boulders and loose-stone clumps. Workers break boulders or gather scree for rough stone.

items.label: Harvest plants
items.tooltip: Click ripe shrubs, apple trees or junipers, or drag an area. Workers gather fruit and keep the plants for later harvests.

items.label: Clear plants
items.tooltip: Permanently remove shrubs, flowers and reeds. Shrubs yield a cutting; flowers and reeds yield no items.

items.label: Cancel orders
items.tooltip: Click or drag across marked blocks, trees, stones and shrubs to cancel work. Partial progress is kept.

items.label: Storage
items.tooltip: Drag over clear, walkable ground to create a storage zone. Select a finished zone to choose accepted goods.

items.label: Fishing
items.tooltip: Drag along a shore to make a fishing zone. Dwarves allowed to fish cast from it until the colony keeps enough fish.

items.label: Farming
items.tooltip: Crop-growing zones are planned. Fields and farming work are not available yet.

items.label: Animal pasture
items.tooltip: Grazing zones for livestock are planned. Pasture designation and animal keeping are not available yet.

items.label: Dwarves
items.tooltip: Your dwarves, their current work and rest

items.label: Labor
items.tooltip: Manage real dwarf work permissions in the colony roster

items.label: Settlement flag
items.tooltip: Locate and inspect the settlement's flag. Packed flags can be placed again.

items.label: Trade
items.tooltip: View the trade preview. Merchants and trading are not available yet.

items.label: Block Inspector
items.tooltip: Inspect technical terrain data and generation diagnostics

items.label: World Build
items.tooltip: Inspect terrain generation and world-building diagnostics.

items.label: Cave explorer
items.tooltip: Highlight caves, jump to their depth and preview interiors

items.label: Dwarf tools
items.tooltip: Spawn dwarves, test walking and exercise work/rest behavior

items.label: Water
items.tooltip: Inspect spring, waterfalls and outlet; test a dam and finite withdrawals.

items.label: Arrival status
items.tooltip: Show wildlife arrival opportunities and their last results.

items.label: Item stamper
items.tooltip: DEV: Put any item on a floor: pick it, set the amount and wood, then click floors. Dwarves carry goods to storage.

items.label: Remove objects
items.tooltip: DEV: Remove trees, stones, bushes and flowers at once, without drops. Click one or drag an area; Esc to finish. There is no Undo.

items.label: Time & weather tools
items.tooltip: Advance game time or cycle weather to test seasonal and weather systems.
